notes.title: v1.0.6 - BEST SOUND at Compfest 11
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34652920/217e086c98c19ede2b4db5623bddb732d1d73f1f.png

Always good to see our efforts being recognized. Special mention to Domenick DeFrank, Dirham Mohamad, Ghinazahira Hanoum, Rahthino Giovanni, and the rest of the audio team! (Their names are in the credits tab in-game. Look it up!)

As for the patch, what's new this time?

More pixelated look. Antialiasing in a pixel graphic is a no, I'm sure.
All NPC assists during combat should work as intended from now on.
To prevent overlapping sound effects, attacks that unleash multiple sprites at the same frame now work differently.


- Baskara Eurgava

notes.title: v1.0.5 - Keyboard + Mouse! Steam Summer Sale 50%!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652920/abf91c883cdbc49920cc351da8d75e167647d348.png

So, what's new this time?
New key bindings: Play with keyboard + mouse. (Yep. Finally. Use your mouse to aim that pointer this time.)
New aerial attacks, executable by pressing projectile/ranged attack button while jumping. Did you see the video on facebook/twitter/instagram?
Easier combat in the first dozen of fights, for a more approachable difficulty curve.

Enjoy the discount! Nagas guide you!
- Baskara

"...Sekte Naga Korup mengirim begitu banyak prajurit, sepertinya mereka ingin memastikan tidak ada peziarah yang tersisa di Makam Senza. Kini kita berada di lokasi yang aman, kita bisa bicara empat mata sekarang..."

Have fun, and end the Magic Miasma!

notes.title: Updated to v1.0.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652920/1e4c569f965c1793c9d4ae45f9269f8a680a7a70.png

So, what's new this time?

Updated the UI a bit. Whenever a multichoice appear, it will tell you how to pick one of the three available options.
Animated more NPCs in their idle state. They are not statues.
Tidying up the coding so the game's ready for other language translations. Wait for the next announcement for more details.


Oh, and if you folks haven't noticed...
Did you know that, during game options popup or during resting interface, you can use keyboard's QE or controller's shoulder buttons to switch between tabs? It was already mentioned in the Steam Discussion.

- Baskara

notes.title: A solution for blackscreen problem
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652920/b109d02e423def73b911c6d8e1006f82c1d51ecf.png

April 9th 2019

If this happens, it means you probably have tried the previous version of the game sometime ago, and the save files from that version remained in your PC. You just need to clear those save files and start new.

Go to C:\Users\*\AppData\Local and delete the game folder "EURGAVA-TombofSenza".

Should the problem persists, write a comment below or post it in the Steam discussion. Apologies for the inconveniences, and have fun ending the Magic Miasma!

- Baskara

notes.title: Release Countdown Started!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652920/da9a8a686a493bff25ac1307fca23429a3bc269a.png

Are you new to this title? Or did you came from the previous game? Do you have a controller? Keep it with you! That controller will help you survive all the dangers surrounding the Tomb of Senza.

Believe me. It's not going to be a walk in the park. Bandits? Monsters? Those are the least of your worries. The land is rotting thanks to the lethal miasma. Everyone is sick because of it and you are no exception.

If the monsters do not kill you, YOUR SICKNESS PROBABLY WILL!

See for yourself how wary the locals have become! You are not the only one stuck with the problem! Help them so they are willing to help you! Find out how to end the miasma and cure yourself!

==========

That idea above caught your interest? Press that wishlist button now!

- Ibrahim Indra Baskara
